findings.passage:
It is time for bold leadership in the State House to face these issues head-on. We must protect our most fundamental right to vote.
This includes:
Repealing SB202 to protect local election boards
Increasing voting locations to reduce long lines
Expanding language resources to increase participation
Increasing the early voting period to allow for a variety of voting days
Repealing confusing and inconsistent ID laws that do not make our elections more secure
Advocating for the passage of federal voting rights legislation
findings.note: Voting rights policy page on her campaign site (undated, written for her earlier campaign). Lists repealing what it calls confusing and inconsistent ID laws among its aims, and repealing SB 202.

findings.passage: In 2021, they passed SB202 allowing more control of local election boards. The law also reduces the number of ballot boxes, shortens early voting, and takes away weekend voting resulting in lower voting participation.
findings.note: Same campaign page (undated). Her description of what Georgia SB 202 (2021) does.

findings.passage: Additionally, we have seen Republicans pass legislation that suppresses voters with surgical precision. As a State Representative Ruwa stopped bills that would make voting harder.
findings.note: Campaign home page (undated), written about her in the third person. General statement on election laws, no specific ID or citizenship rule named.
